grid.name: MIST v2.5
grid.metallicity_parameter: feh = the grid's own [Fe/H] label, uniform in it

model.z_sun_source: not used: the fit coordinate is the [Fe/H] label

method: profile likelihood of log t in a G window (exact conditional likelihood, mag_window); interval = Delta lnL 0.5, uncalibrated

config.run: phase to (G in (12.0, 14.0)), 22 members, arm a: [Fe/H], dm, A_V fixed at the global fit

isochrone.definition: single-star isochrone (no binaries, no errors) at the posterior median of met/loga/dm/Av, in the observed system: G and BP-RP with CCM89+O'Donnell extinction, R_V=3.1

notes: phase to (G in (12.0, 14.0)), 22 members, arm a: [Fe/H], dm, A_V fixed at the global fit
